players.name: lazy.pf
players.script:
# lazy.pf — never looks at the opponent.
# Strategy: a fixed routine with no sensor reads at all: walk in, kick,
# sweep, block a little, repeat. Predictable, but it never wastes frames
# on checks.
loop {
  move_forward x6
  kick
  sweep
  high_block hold 4
}

players.name: thrower.pf
